vulnerabilities.name: Agent runs with all permission checks turned off
vulnerabilities.description:
Every tool call, including shell commands and file deletes, runs without approval. One prompt injection in a file, issue or web page the agent reads can run any command as you.

Found: --yolo
vulnerabilities.solution: Remove the bypass. Allow specific tools instead, and run unattended agents in a throwaway sandbox with no secrets and no network beyond what the task needs.
